“但是对于这个蒋羡耘，我有个情况。”

“你说。”

“我得到消息，羡耘同学早在四年前在湖南的时候就加入了红党。所以，先生，我们一方面，要对其着重培养，一方面也要警惕。”

现在是合作时期。国党内部绝大多数人是不赞成合作，且很抵制的。

校长这个人明面上对于合作的态度处于中立派。

孙先生格局很大：“他是红党，但也是我国党成员嘛，你呀，不必要楚河汉界分的那么清。如今是合作时期，就算他是红党，那也是我国党的忠勇之士嘛。都要好好栽培。”

“是，先生说的是。”

“你呀，不要受到影响。如今我们内部有很多人反对合作，而且这个声音啊还不断。为此呢，我很不高兴，你要

“是。”

等人回来后，同学们都是一脸羡慕的眼神看着蒋羡耘，第一名实在太被上头器重了。

上完了教室内的理论课，又上课堂外的军训课目。

一开始是最为简单的训练，列队，还有踢正步，以及跑圈。

“都站好了！胡棕难。”

“到！”

“曾阔晴！”

“到！”

“包国维！”

“到！”

一个个的先点名。

实训教官有些严格，也出身于保定军校。上理论课的教官就温和不少。

教官直接走到包国维面前，脸挨着脸就那么几公分了，再近一点都能亲上去：“你，看着我！回答我，吃了饭吗？”

“报告教官，吃了！”

"But I have a situation regarding this Jiang Xianyun."

"You said."

"I got the news that Xianyun joined the Red Party four years ago when he was in Hunan. So, sir, on the one hand, we must focus on cultivating him, and on the other hand, we must be vigilant."

Now is the time for collaboration.The vast majority of people within the Kuomintang disapprove of cooperation and are very resistant.

On the surface, the principal is on the neutral side when it comes to cooperation.

Mr. Sun has a big picture: "He is a member of the Red Party, but he is also a member of the Party of my country. You don't need to make such a clear distinction between Chu and Han. Now is the period of cooperation. Even if he is a member of the Red Party, he is still a loyal and brave man of the Party of my country. We must cultivate him well."

"Yes, that's what sir said."

After finishing the theoretical classes in the classroom, I took military training courses outside the classroom.

It started with the simplest training, lining up, kicking forward, and running circles.

Name them one by one first.

The practical training instructor is a bit strict, and he also came from Baoding Military Academy.The instructors in the theoretical classes were much gentler.

The instructor walked directly to Bao Guowei, his face was only a few centimeters away, and he could have kissed him if he was any closer: "You, look at me!Answer me, have you eaten?"
